summary: Ingest ASV Genesis, John, Revelation under new 'biblical' tradition
description: Add the complete ASV (American Standard Version, 1901) text of Genesis (all 50 ch), the Gospel of John, and Revelation to the guru corpus as three primary singleton works under a new 'biblical' tradition. Source: openbibleinfo/American-Standard-Version-Bible (USX w/ paragraphs + footnotes, public domain). TWO streams: ingest (docs/ingest/ nodes 01-16, per text) then Pass D (docs/dossiers/ nodes D1-D6, per work) — Pass D forces a campaign bump c10->c11. Source-ids: genesis-asv, gospel-of-john-asv, revelation-asv. Genesis is ingested COMPLETE and tagged fully; the 12-50 lineage noise is culled at the node-11 REVIEW gate (not hand-pruned at tagging), keeping anything worthwhile. Dossier generation (D2) runs through llamacpp LOCAL (Qwen on the 3090) — set input_budget 6000-8000, pin model, GPU announce+permission. Plan STOPS at every user gate: node 11 tag-review (queue-only), D3/D4 dossier gates, and the terminal node 15 publish + D6 export (user ships). Never auto-promote, never publish, never touch prod. Downstream/out-of-scope (guru-web): the new tradition needs an authorship-era assignment for the retrieval era-dampen lever.
